persons.name: Bhūpatīndramalladeva
persons.evidence: śrīśrī jaya bhūpatīndramalladevasana cukacākasa deva pratiṣṭhā siddhāgni a(6)yutāhuti yajña yāṅāyā thva sāphuli

date.as_written: samvat 825 bhādrapada śukla da(7)śami mūlanakṣatra śanaiścaravārakvahnu

purpose: deva pratiṣṭhā siddhāgni ayutāhuti yajña yāṅāyā
notes: cukacākasa refers to a small courtyard/quadrangle (Newari: cukacā) in the royal palace complex of Bhaktapur where King Bhūpatīndra Malla performed the ayutāhuti yajña and deity consecration.
